Name: More Expensive Tool Upgrades by Afrove
Author: Afrove
Description:
[b]Version 1.5 is fully working now.
What This Mod Does[/b]
This mod makes getting tool upgrades at Clint's shop a bit harder by raising the gold and metal bar costs.
Perfect for modded playthrough since the vanilla values are really pretty easy to accomplish.

[b]Default Mod Costs[/b]
Here are the starting values when you load up the mod:
[b]Copper Upgrade:[/b] 5 Copper Bars + 4,000 Gold
[b]Steel Upgrade:[/b] 25 Iron Bars + 10,000 Gold
[b]Gold Upgrade:[/b] 50 Gold Bars + 20,000 Gold
[b]Iridium Upgrade:[/b] 100 Iridium Bars + 50,000 Gold

[b]Change It Anytime[/b]
Don't like these exact numbers? No problem! If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] installed, you can open the mod settings in-game and change every gold price and bar count to whatever you want.

Manifest.Name: More Expensive Tool Upgrades
Manifest.Description: Allows custom gold costs and metal bar requirements for Clint's tool upgrades via Generic Mod Config Menu.
